decision_summary: The promoted C4 residual-add plus centered-RMSNorm kernel now contributes only 37.396384 ms, or 0.803400% of the P513/C32 prefix kernel union, so further local work on that chain is no longer a leading priority.

After removing the exact-M32 gate/up cross-stream overlap, NVFP4 M32 gate/up and down remain the first two Prefill opportunities with 2,280.888320 ms of combined marginal exposure, or 49.001152% of prefix union.

The next bounded screens are an exact-M32 gate/up single-slot raw-weight cp.async narrow reopen, a table-free E4M3-to-BF16 scale constructor covering both exact-M32 NVFP4 shapes, and a down-only N160/320-thread balanced-grid topology. None changes production dispatch before its same-binary hard gate passes.

A general scheduler-level double or triple buffer remains lower priority: the measured single-request prefix kernel-span idle is only 1.940194%, while the leading phase-local kernel groups expose materially more time.

protocol.prompt_construction: 501 space-separated copies of the ASCII word hello

attribution_method.nvtx_selection: Completed q3x.* push/pop ranges, resolving registered strings through coalesce(NVTX_EVENTS.text, StringIds.value via textId); hotspot ranking uses q3x.prefill.prefix_tile.
attribution_method.runtime_selection: CUDA Runtime API calls whose host start and end lie inside a phase range on the same globalTid.
attribution_method.raw_kernel_ns: Sum of kernel end minus start; overlapping streams are counted more than once.
attribution_method.union_kernel_ns: Length of the merged GPU kernel interval union.
attribution_method.span_kernel_ns: Last associated kernel end minus first associated kernel start.
attribution_method.idle_ns: Kernel span minus kernel interval union.
attribution_method.overlap_ns: Raw kernel sum minus kernel interval union.
attribution_method.marginal_critical_path_ns: Full prefix kernel union minus the union after removing every interval in one exact demangled-kernel-name group.
attribution_method.cross_check: The same analysis reproduced every recorded top-eight marginal value in the prior post-GDN SQLite before it was applied to this trace.

ranking_summary.gate_up_raw_share_is_not_critical_share: The raw 1739.878944 ms double-counts 391.938720 ms of gate/up overlap. The current-timeline marginal exposure is 1347.940224 ms.

priority_decision.first: Narrowly reopen the retained M17-M31 single-slot raw-weight cp.async mechanism for exact-M32 gate/up only. The historical same-shape probe reached about 1.06x in isolation but had too little M17-M31 whole-model coverage; the post-C4 exact-M32 gate/up group alone now exposes 28.958289% of prefix union. Down remains excluded because its adjacent raw-weight screens regressed.
priority_decision.second: Screen an exact-M32 NVFP4 table-free E4M3 scale-bit constructor against both gate/up and down. It removes the remaining 512-byte shared scale codebook and its hot-loop indexed loads without adding a second buffer.
priority_decision.parallel_down_only_screen: Screen an N160/320-thread exact-down topology. It reduces grid and repeated CTA setup by 20% while preserving 320 output warps and exact per-warp arithmetic order.

hard_gate.common: Candidates remain test-only until exact-bit, replay, guard, Graph, invalid-input, resource, and same-binary performance gates pass.
hard_gate.gate_up_raw_weight_cp_async: Require block 256; at most 51 registers; exactly 27648 static shared bytes; zero local memory; at least five active CTAs/SM; emitted LDGSTS, dependency-barrier, and shared-to-register ownership instructions; every isolated distribution cell at least 1.03x without a round reversal; and every production dual-stream pair cell plus aggregate at least 1.02x without a round reversal.
hard_gate.table_free_e4m3: Require 256-code exact E4M3FN-to-BF16 bits; block 256; at most 50 registers; exactly 23040 static shared bytes; zero local memory; at least five active CTAs/SM; every shape/distribution cell non-regressing; and weighted speedup at least 1.02x. Weight gate/up and down by 128:64 production calls in each distribution, then divide the sum of weighted baseline cell medians by the corresponding candidate sum. The production dual-stream gate/up pair must independently reach at least 1.02x aggregate without a round reversal.
hard_gate.down_n160: Require block 320, grid 32, at most 51 registers, exactly 28160 static shared bytes, zero local memory, at least four active CTAs/SM, every measured round non-regressing, and paired-median speedup at least 1.03x.

priority_decision.after_nvfp4: If neither bounded mechanism passes, move to the ranked FP8 M32 shapes rather than reopening evidence-closed NVFP4 buffering variants.
priority_decision.scheduler: Defer general double/triple buffering to a multi-request continuous-batching milestone with explicit request, KV, workspace, fairness, cancellation, tail-latency, and memory-admission ownership.

limitations: This is one no-warmup profiled process for hotspot selection, not a repeated latency distribution or release SLA.
Nsight Systems perturbs absolute time. No pre/post whole-profile speedup is inferred by comparing this capture with an older capture.
The C4 production claim uses its same-kernel C0 bracket and unprofiled B-C-C-B gates; the phase trace only establishes its new rank and exposure.
Marginal exposure is a current-timeline removal calculation, not an additive or counterfactual speedup prediction.
No Nsight Compute counters, multi-request throughput, continuous batching, power, energy, tail-latency, cancellation, or admission result is claimed.
